decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The window formed in the eastern elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the northern, western or eastern wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The garage shall only be used for the parking of vehicles or a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of No. 29 Avenue Crescent and for no other purpose. It shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or other business use or as a separate dwelling and shall not include toilet, bathroom or kitchen facilities.
description: Erection of a detached single storey garage to rear of house
